cards.text: Jeremiah, a prophet to Judah, has just heard the LORD say Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble (Jeremiah 9:11). Now a question goes out: who is wise enough to understand this? Why is the land destroyed and scorched like a desert, so no one can pass through it?

cards.question: Someone answers the question of why the land is destroyed. The ___ answers.
The LORD says the land is ruined because the people have forsaken His ___ and have not obeyed His voice.

cards.text: Instead, the LORD says, they followed the stubbornness of their hearts. That's the GPS saying turn left nine times and you going right NINE TIMES because you 'know a shortcut.'

cards.question: Following their stubborn hearts, who did the people go after?
The LORD says the people came up with chasing the Baals all on their own, with nobody teaching them.

cards.text: So the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says He will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink. That's not a menu, friend. That's a WARNING.

cards.question: After the wormwood and the poisoned water, where does the LORD say He will scatter the people?

answers.text: Among nations they have never known
Among the cities of the Philistines

cards.text: And He will send a sword after them until He has finished them off. This is where the stubborn road ends.

Then the LORD of Hosts says to take note and summon the wailing women, and send for the most skillful among them. When it's this serious, you don't call the guy who watched one video. You call the BEST.

cards.question: The LORD wants the wailing women to come quickly and lament over the people. Whose eyes are meant to overflow with tears?

cards.text: Then the sound of wailing is heard from Zion: 'How devastated we are! How great is our shame!' Friend, that's a sound you don't forget.

cards.question: The people in Zion cry that they have abandoned the land because their dwellings have been torn down.

cards.text: Now the women are told to open their ears to the word of the LORD, and to teach their daughters to wail and one another to lament. When grief gets passed down like a family recipe, you know it's heavy.

cards.question: Here's the reason for all the wailing. ___ has climbed in through the windows and entered the fortresses.

cards.text: Death has come in to cut off the children from the streets and the young men from the town squares. No jokes here, friend. This one hurts.
Then comes the word of the LORD: the corpses of men will fall like dung on the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper. The LORD doesn't soften it, and I won't either.

cards.question: The LORD says someone will come along behind and gather up the fallen.

cards.text: Then the LORD says not to let the wise man boast in his wisdom, or the strong man in his strength. Friend, I shared a junk drawer with dead batteries who argued all day about who had the most charge left, and not one of them could run a TV remote.

cards.question: There's a third man on the list. The LORD says the wealthy man shouldn't boast in his ___.
So if someone is going to boast, what does the LORD say to boast in?

answers.text: That he understands and knows the LORD
That he keeps every rule perfectly
That he gives more than his neighbors

cards.text: And the One they'd know is the LORD, who exercises loving devotion, justice and righteousness on the earth. Now THAT'S worth bragging about, way more than any battery's charge.

cards.question: The LORD says loving devotion, justice and righteousness are things He puts up with but doesn't delight in.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, 'Behold, the days are coming,' when He will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh.

cards.question: Judah is on the LORD's list of those He will punish for being circumcised only in the flesh, right alongside Egypt, Edom, Ammon and Moab.

cards.text: So are all the inhabitants of the desert who clip the hair of their temples. And the LORD says all these nations are uncircumcised.

cards.question: And the whole house of Israel? The LORD says they are uncircumcised in ___.
